data.long_meaning: One who is golden or radiant. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ruchih' which means 'to please' or 'to attract'. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby boy. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Ruchir usually hope their child will grow to embody golden, brilliant and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name Ruchir is a symbol of the golden god, Lord Indra, who is known as the god of rain, thunder, and power. Indra is praised for his golden aura and divine grace, and naming a child Ruchir is a way to bless them with the qualities of this powerful deity.
